Name: Galaxy Bed
Author: L0veRaven
Description:
This galaxy bed with a teddy bear is here to provide a galaxy/witchy aesthetic to your game.

Check out [url=https://www.l0veraven.com/]my website[/url]﻿ to find ways to support and follow me!


[b][u]Game Config Toggle:[/u][/b]

True -> (Default) Robin will sell the bed in her shop
False -> Will replace default bed texture



[b][u]Bed For Sale = True

[/u][/b]If you directly edit the config.json, the name you're looking for is "BedForSale".[b]
[u]
[/u][/b]Adult bed is 1,500g
Child bed is 2,000g



[u][b]Plans for Future Updates:
[/b][/u]
- Add beds without stuffed animal
- Add double beds
- Add beds with other stuffed animals
- Add beds with different colors but same general design



[b][u]MODDER'S NOTES:

[/u][/b]If you'd like to provide translations for this mod, please contact me first! I'd rather translations be attached to this mod. I currently have no intentions of translating the mod since I only speak English.
